shots.vo: No skill is ever wasted. Today we learn to take a *Boeing 747* into the air.
Takeoff weight — almost *four hundred tonnes*. And you will lift all of it with these two hands.
In front of you — the *control wheel*. Pull back and the nose goes up. Turn it and the plane banks.
Under your feet — the *rudder pedals*. You steer along the runway with them.
Between the seats — *four thrust levers*. One for each engine.
The *flap lever*: extend the flaps and the wing gets bigger, so the plane lifts off at a lower speed.
Brakes released. Levers forward. The run takes almost *three kilometres* of runway. At about three hundred kilometres an hour, pull the wheel back.
Gear up: this little lever with a *tiny wheel* on the end.
You are above the clouds. *Nine hundred* kilometres an hour.
Now the bad news: the landing lesson is in the next episode. Would you take *the controls*?
